entry_item.definition: [-v,. caus. of aril-] ,To clean, cleanse, purify; to wipe off or out; to destroy, exterminate, annihilate, liquidate; to remove, eliminate, stop; to cancel, erase; to cause to disappear; to weed; to cure or heal by supernatural powers.

example.definition: To remove danger, relieve of fears.
To heal or cure illness by supernatural powers.
To free oneself from sin, expiate sins
To clean oneself from passions or attachment to the material world
To remove the evil; to get rid of poison:
To do away with theft and lies

entry_item.definition: 1. T. sbyong ba; S. vipodhaya-.To cleanse, purify; to dematerialize (by regiting tarni).

example.definition: T, stong par sbyong ba, To establish the VOID (see xoγusun), part of the evocation act

entry_item.definition: 2. T. sel ba; S. apoha. Progressive elimination (definition of an entity by stating what it is not)

example.definition: T. sgrib pa sel ba (bsal ba); S. nivaraṇa-nishkarshana. Elimination of corruptions. See nisvanis.
